1.$description: Primary body text. Standalone content read as part of normal task flow, general copy, descriptions, empty-state text, input values.

1.$description: Assistive text dependent on a primary label or control, helper text, inline validation, instructional hints. Not standalone copy.

pressed.$description: Ink 900 at 16%. Proposal: the documented compact pressed value (4%) is too faint to read as feedback.

shadow.$description: Floating, non-blocking. One step below Dialog.

border.$description: Status info at 48%. Proposal: no documented toast stroke. The icon and text also carry the severity.
Status success at 48%. Proposal: no documented toast stroke. The icon and text also carry the severity.
Status warning at 48%. Proposal: no documented toast stroke. The icon and text also carry the severity.
Status critical at 48%. Proposal: no documented toast stroke. The icon and text also carry the severity.

scrolled.$description: Scrolled state: elevation appears when content moves under the bar (requirement: needs a distinct scrolled state).

default.$description: Ink 900 at 4%.

pressed.$description: Ink 900 at 16%. Proposal: pressed is darker than hover in a list.

typography.$description: Show more and show less control.

size.$description: Square tool. Inline icon action reuses Navigation values (visual-design-decisions 4.6).

default.$description: Floating toolbar sits above the text (menu tier elevation).
Active format: a fill change (Nav selected gradient), with aria-pressed. Not shadow alone.
Teal icon in addition to the fill.

dark.$description: DRAFT dark theme. The source token files have no dark values (TASKS.md: 'Dark theme values' is open). Derived from the Ink/Sage/Teal primitives. Needs design sign-off before it is promoted into tokens/semantic. Selector: :root[data-theme="dark"].

extend.$description: Draft dark-only surface and accent steps. Literal hex is allowed here ONLY. Promote to tokens/primitive/color.json once approved.

contrast.$description: WCAG AA checks run by scripts/build-modes.mjs. text = 4.5:1, ui = 3:1. fg/bg are semantic token names.

density.$description: DRAFT density modes. Default = the semantic tokens as authored (no override). Compact and Spacious scale space and control height; type size, radius and icon size stay fixed (cross-cutting spec: fixed type scale). Compact keeps 44px touch hit areas via the component hit-area rule. Selector: :root[data-density="compact"|"spacious"].
